Here is the complete picture: **EdgeController** directly depends on 7 service interfaces, each with one concrete implementation.

---

## EdgeController
`application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/controller/EdgeController.java`

---

### Service Interfaces → Implementations

| # | Interface | Interface File | Implementation Class | Implementation File |
|---|-----------|---------------|---------------------|-------------------|
| 1 | `EdgeService` | `common/dao-api/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/dao/edge/EdgeService.java` | `EdgeServiceImpl` | `dao/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/dao/edge/EdgeServiceImpl.java` |
| 2 | `TbEdgeService` | `application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/entitiar/edge/TbEdgeService.java` | `DefaultTbEdgeService` | `application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/entitiar/edge/DefaultTbEdgeService.java` |
| 3 | `AccessControlService` | `application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/security/permission/AccessControlService.java` | `DefaultAccessControlService` | `application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/security/permission/DefaultAccessControlService.java` |
| 4 | `EdgeUpgradeInstructionsService` | `application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/edge/instructions/EdgeUpgradeInstructionsService.java` | `DefaultEdgeUpgradeInstructionsService` | `application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/edge/instructions/DefaultEdgeUpgradeInstructionsService.java` |
| 5 | `RuleChainService` | `common/dao-api/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/dao/rule/RuleChainService.java` | `BaseRuleChainService` | `dao/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/dao/rule/BaseRuleChainService.java` |
| 6 | `EdgeRpcService` | `application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/edge/rpc/EdgeRpcService.java` | `EdgeGrpcService` | `application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/edge/rpc/EdgeGrpcService.java` |
| 7 | `EdgeInstallInstructionsService` | `application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/edge/instructions/EdgeInstallInstructionsService.java` | `DefaultEdgeInstallInstructionsService` | `application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/edge/instructions/DefaultEdgeInstallInstructionsService.java` |

---

**Notable pattern:** The two DAO-layer interfaces (`EdgeService`, `RuleChainService`) live in `common/dao-api` with their implementations in `dao/`. The five application-layer services live entirely within `application/`, following a `Default*` / `*Impl` naming convention. `EdgeRpcService` is the exception — its implementation `EdgeGrpcService` reflects the gRPC transport used for Edge communication.
